title: Airbnb Booking Nightly Rate Leaderboard
dataSources: Airbnb bookings (`airbnb:booking`), Vrbo reservations (`vrbo:reservation`), Airbnb payouts (`airbnb:payout`), and guest reviews (`guest:review`).
app: Airbnb booking exports, Vrbo reservation webhooks, Airbnb payout statements, guest review logs, and turnover checklists streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=airbnb:booking nightly_rate_usd=*
| stats sum(nightly_rate_usd) as total_value, avg(nightly_rate_usd) as avg_value by listing_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks listing values by total and average nightly rate across Airbnb booking events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `nightly_rate_usd` values for each Airbnb booking event and review total and average nightly rate by listing.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total nightly rate.
grandmaExplanation: It compares which listing shows the biggest nightly rate numbers in your Airbnb booking data.
